experiments.summary: rank-one, ray, relative determinant, gamma real > 0, gauge, Ward, approximate bound on 200 random complex instances with non-unitary D
forced H(x)=1: kernel dimension 1 and Re(conj(Hz)<g,Dz>) = gamma|Hz|^2
bilinear pairing breaks Ward; D* in place of D^-1 breaks the ray
2x2 crossing satisfies every M74 identity yet A(s) has a negative eigenvalue for s > 0: the secular algebra alone cannot exclude a crossing
min/max of pi^2 e/|z|^2 beyond -1/+1; control without zero sum gives e = 0
telescoped mass exact; optimal constant decreasing to 1/4 (signal); 1/4 + 0.01 fails at K = 80
entry derivative <= 2 + 4 pi K; window inside (0,1) and below -|z|^2/(2 pi^2); true negative run >= ~198 x 2 eta (eta is crude)

actual canonical float matrices, K = 2..5, L = 0.25..6: rank-one relation B D - D A = g H holds to 2e-15 (consistent with the Lean theorem); on the 46 float-resolved (K, L) points B > 0, A > 0 and the secular margin 1 - T(L) > 0 (min 4.4e-4 at K = 3, L = 2.75), with det A / det B = 1 - T to 3e-9; the pole and prime channel contributions to T cancel to relative size up to 7e9; CanonicalShiftedSecular regressions on the same matrices: T(a) = 1 to 3e-9 and the shifted overlap identity to 5e-8 at all 46 resolved even roots below the odd floor, and the odd-first determinant identity det B / det A = 1 + H(A^-1 D^-1 g) to 5e-8 relative
experiments.caveat: 50 grid points are below float64 resolution (lambda_min < 1e-10 x matrix scale) and are reported as unresolved, not as signs; no certified enclosure

experiments.summary: on the even boundary-flat carrier, K = 2..5, at L = 0.08..0.62 (prime-free), 0.9, 1.3, 1.5 (prime cells) and exactly at the seams log 3, log 4, log 5: the first identity to 5e-8 and the Euler identity to 1.2e-6 relative (5-point finite differences of the executable canonical matrix against Gauss-Legendre quadrature plus the exact prime sum)

a vector with nonzero coefficient sum misses the Euler identity by the predicted boundary term e'_z(0)(W(L) - rho(L))/L (2.0753 observed vs 2.0753 predicted); adding cCorrection twice misses the first identity by 2 cCorrectionIntegrand(L)|z|^2 (0.44946 vs 0.44946)
lambda_max of the Euler form below the Q-NEG-EULER bound at L = 0.25, 0.5, 0.9 eps_K for K = 2..5

the Euler form is negative definite on the even carrier up to L = 0.553 (K = 2), 0.425 (3), 0.379 (4), 0.355 (5), and about 0.30 at K = 16; the even ground stays positive on the whole prime-free window for K = 2..16 (minimum 0.096 at K = 2 down to 0.003 at K = 16, always at the right end), so no even contact is seen below log 2
